text: In 1997, a parent’s complaint led a school board to vote to remove Judy Blume's Forever from the one area middle school that carried it in Elgin, Illinois. In 1999, a school librarian asked the school board to reconsider its 1997 decision, but the book remained off the shelf after a 3-3 vote on lifting the ban. On January 22, 2002, the School District U-46 Board voted 5-2 to reinstate Forever. By 1982, schools in Pennsylvania, Florida, and Ohio had challenged it for not promoting abstinence or monogamy.
